summary.en: Houthi forces have stepped up cross-border attacks, launching drones toward Mecca that Saudi air defenses intercepted and striking Saudi airports, while a Saudi-led coalition precision operation hit Houthi targets in Yemen. The Houthis are reported to be using Russian satellites to coordinate strikes, and a cargo vessel bound for Pakistan was targeted near the Hormuz Strait. UN investigators are probing the death of a staff member in Houthi custody, and fighting around Taiz and Aden has displaced 290,000 people, including pregnant women. The conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

background.title: Yemeni civil war (2014–present)
background.extract: The Yemeni civil war is an ongoing multilateral civil war that began in late 2014 mainly between the Rashad al-Alimi-led Presidential Leadership Council and the Mahdi al-Mashat-led Supreme Political Council, along with their respective supporters and allies. Both sides claim to constitute the official government of Yemen while the Presidential Leadership Council is recognized by the United Nations as the official government.
background.extractNb: Borgerkrigen i Jemen er en pågående konflikt i Jemen mellom Jemens internasjonalt tidligere anerkjente regjering, ledet av Abdrabbuh Mansur Hadi, og Houthi-bevegelsen. Begge sider har allierte, i form av styrker, våpenstøtte og informasjon, og krigen anses å være en del av den pågående konflikten mellom Saudi-Arabia og Iran.
